scope: Full10statements/reference solutions/rubrics, all boundary and degenerate cases. Independent mathematical proof review, not typography-only. No activation by reviewer.
hash_algorithm: SHA256(UTF8(json.dumps({k:problem[k] for k in [title,statement,criterions,reference_solution]}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))); Python default comma-space/colon-space separators, no newline.
